title: Adscensores Cerasi Texture Pack
description: Cherry Blossoms are so pretty, wouldn't you like for them to be everywhere? On your armor, on your horse...The possibilities are endless!
body:
_"Cherry Blossoms are so pretty, wouldn't you like for them to be everywhere? On your armor, on your horse...The possibilities are endless!"_ - _The Adscensores Cerasi_\
This texturepack aims to replace a good portion of the item and block textures in the game with cherry variants. Fair warning, the armor texture breaks when an armor trim is applied.
